title: 🩺 Wellbeing360 — Unified Digital Healthcare Platform
features:
1. Intelligent doctor search and appointment scheduling
  2. Prescription tracking and in-app medicine ordering
  3. Dual pharmacy integration (corporate and hospital)
  4. Real-time order updates and push notifications
  5. Inventory and stock management for pharmacists
  6. Admin dashboard with analytics and performance metrics
description:
Wellbeing360 is a comprehensive full-stack web and mobile platform designed to digitalize and streamline internal healthcare services within organizations. The system allows employees to book doctor appointments, manage prescriptions, order medicines, and access personalized health updates — all from a unified platform.

Meanwhile, admins, doctors, pharmacists, and HR teams can efficiently manage healthcare operations through a secure, role-based web dashboard.
